title: The Innocents Abroad — Volume 05
summary: "The Innocents Abroad — Volume 05" by Mark Twain is part of a travel book published in 1869. This volume continues Twain's humorous chronicle of his 1867 voyage aboard the Quaker City through Europe and the Holy Land. Twain contrasts romantic travel literature with reality, lampooning grandiose travelogues while observing how history is commodified and trivialized.
